# Stockroom — Inventory Management

A complete, production-style inventory application: a dashboard with KPIs and
low-stock alerts, a searchable/filterable product catalogue with full CRUD,
categories and suppliers management, an auditable stock-movement ledger, and CSV
export.

**Live demo: https://jrhgma9jb6.dev.ap-jt.com**

## Features

- **Dashboard** — total inventory value, product counts, units in stock, low-stock
  and out-of-stock alerts, plus the most recent stock movements.
- **Products** — create, edit and delete items; live search; filter by category
  and supplier; sort by name, quantity or stock value; low-stock-only toggle.
- **Product detail** — per-item stock history and quick stock adjustments.
- **Stock movements** — record stock in, stock out and counted (set) movements
  with reason and reference; quantity is always derived from the ledger, so stock
  levels can never silently drift.
- **Categories & suppliers** — full CRUD with referential-integrity guards that
  block deleting a record still in use.
- **CSV export** — download the current catalogue with category, supplier and
  stock-value columns.

## Tech stack

| Layer     | Choice                                              |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| Framework | Next.js 16 (App Router, standalone output)          |
| Language  | TypeScript (strict)                                 |
| Styling   | Tailwind CSS v4                                     |
| Database  | SQLite via `better-sqlite3` (persisted volume)      |
| Runtime   | Node 24, Alpine 3.22 container image                |

Data lives in a SQLite file under `DATA_DIR` (default `/data`) and is seeded
automatically on first boot, so the demo is useful immediately.

## API

| Method | Route                   | Purpose                          |
| ------ | ----------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| GET    | `/api/stats`            | Dashboard aggregates             |
| GET    | `/api/products`         | List with search/filter/sort     |
| POST   | `/api/products`         | Create a product                 |
| PATCH  | `/api/products/:id`     | Update a product                 |
| DELETE | `/api/products/:id`     | Delete a product                 |
| GET    | `/api/movements`        | List stock movements             |
| POST   | `/api/movements`        | Record a movement                |
| GET    | `/api/categories`       | List categories                  |
| POST   | `/api/categories`       | Create a category                |
| GET    | `/api/suppliers`        | List suppliers                   |
| POST   | `/api/suppliers`        | Create a supplier                |
| GET    | `/api/export`           | CSV export of the catalogue      |

## Run locally

```bash
npm install
npm run dev          # http://localhost:3000
```

Then build for production:

```bash
npm run build
npm start
```

## Run with Docker

```bash
docker build -t stockroom .
docker run -p 3000:3000 -v stockroom-data:/data stockroom
```

## Project structure

```
app/                 Pages and API route handlers
components/          Client UI components (tables, forms, modals)
lib/db.ts            SQLite connection and migrations
lib/repo.ts          Data-access queries
lib/seed.ts          First-boot demo data
lib/types.ts         Shared domain types
lib/format.ts        Currency/date formatting and stock status
```
